feature: Nutritional Values Display and Input System
workflow_rationale: Multi-layer feature adding protein, carbohydrates, and fat fields to products. Extends existing calories/allergens pattern across database schema, TypeScript types, ProductCard display, and admin input forms. Single service (Next.js) but touches multiple layers (database, backend types, frontend UI, admin panel).

phases.name: Database Schema
phases.description: Add nutritional values columns (protein, carbohydrates, fat) to products table with proper constraints and data types

subtasks.description: Create migration to add nutritional columns to products table

verification.expected: Contains ALTER TABLE products ADD COLUMN statements for protein, carbohydrates, fat as DECIMAL(8,2)

subtasks.notes: Add three columns: protein DECIMAL(8,2), carbohydrates DECIMAL(8,2), fat DECIMAL(8,2). All nullable, with CHECK constraints >= 0. Follow existing pattern from calories field (line 38 in 002_products_price_ledger.sql).

phases.name: TypeScript Type Definitions
phases.description: Update TypeScript interfaces to include nutritional values in Product, ProductInsert, and ProductUpdate types

subtasks.description: Add nutritional fields to Product interface and related types

verification.expected: Product interface contains protein, carbohydrates, fat as number | null

subtasks.notes: Update Product interface (line 230), ProductInsert (line 251), ProductUpdate (line 270). Add: protein: number | null, carbohydrates: number | null, fat: number | null. Follow pattern of calories field (line 238).

subtasks.description: Update ProductCardData interface for display component

verification.expected: ProductCardData interface includes protein, carbohydrates, fat fields

subtasks.notes: Update ProductCardData interface (line 40) to add protein, carbohydrates, fat as number | null. Must match Product type from database.ts.

phases.name: ProductCard Display
phases.description: Add nutritional values display to ProductCard component following existing calories/allergens pattern

subtasks.description: Create NutritionalInfo component for displaying macronutrients

verification.instructions: Verify NutritionalInfo component displays protein, carbs, fat in a 3-column grid with color-coded labels (blue for protein, green for carbs, orange for fat). Conditionally renders only when data exists.

subtasks.notes: Create NutritionalInfo component similar to ProductInfo (line 277-319). Display in 3-column grid with icons/labels. Color coding: protein (blue-600), carbs (green-600), fat (orange-600). Render only if any nutritional value exists. Format: '{value}g per 100g'.

checks: Product cards show nutritional info section when data exists
No nutritional section shown for products without data
Proper spacing between ProductInfo and NutritionalInfo

subtasks.notes: Add NutritionalInfo component after ProductInfo in DefaultProductCard (around line 435). Controlled by showInfo prop. Pass protein, carbohydrates, fat from product prop.

phases.name: Admin Input Forms
phases.description: Add input fields for nutritional values in product creation/edit forms with validation

subtasks.description: Add nutritional input fields to ProductForm state

verification.expected: ProductFormData interface includes protein, carbohydrates, fat as string fields

subtasks.notes: Update ProductFormData interface (line 32) to add: protein: string, carbohydrates: string, fat: string. Initialize in formData state (line 329) from product props. Follow calories pattern (line 335).

subtasks.description: Create nutritional values input section in form UI

checks: Nutritional values section appears in Additional Info card
Three number inputs for protein, carbs, fat
Inputs have proper labels, placeholders, and step=0.01

subtasks.notes: Add nutritional inputs after allergens field (around line 710) in Additional Info Card. Use 3-column grid layout. Number inputs with type='number', min='0', step='0.01'. Labels: 'Protein (g)', 'Carbohydrates (g)', 'Fat (g)'. Add help text: 'Values per 100g serving'.

subtasks.description: Add validation for nutritional value inputs

verification.instructions: Test form validation: 1) Negative values show error 2) Non-numeric values rejected 3) Empty values allowed (optional) 4) Decimal values with 2 places accepted

subtasks.notes: Update validateForm function (line 386) to add validation for protein, carbohydrates, fat. Check: if value provided, must be valid float >= 0. Follow calories validation pattern (lines 407-412). Allow empty values (optional fields).

subtasks.description: Update form submission to save nutritional values

verification.instructions: Create test product with nutritional values, verify data saved correctly in database. Update existing product, verify changes persisted.

subtasks.notes: Update handleSubmit function (line 427). In newProduct creation (line 442), add protein, carbohydrates, fat fields. Parse to float using parseFloat() if value exists, otherwise null. In updateData (line 488), add same fields. Follow calories pattern (line 449).

phases.name: Integration Testing
phases.description: End-to-end verification that nutritional values flow correctly from admin input through database to public display

steps: 2. Start dev server: npm run dev
4. Create product with nutritional values (protein: 25.5, carbs: 30.0, fat: 10.5)
7. Verify nutritional info displays correctly on ProductCard
9. Verify changes reflected on public menu
10. Test legacy product (no nutritional data) - verify no errors, graceful handling

subtasks.notes: This subtask ensures backward compatibility with existing products (those without nutritional data) and validates the complete data flow from admin input to public display.

parallel_groups.reason: Both depend only on phase-2-types, work on different files (ProductCard vs admin form), no conflicts

parallelism.speedup_estimate: 1.3x faster than sequential - phases 3 and 4 can run in parallel after phase 2 completes

acceptance_criteria: Database migration adds protein, carbohydrates, fat columns with CHECK constraints
TypeScript types updated in database.ts and ProductCard.tsx
ProductCard displays nutritional info when data exists, hidden when null
Admin form accepts and validates nutritional value inputs (decimal, non-negative)
Existing products without nutritional data display correctly (backward compatible)
New products with nutritional values save and display correctly
Form validation rejects negative values and non-numeric inputs

verification_steps.name: Unit Tests
verification_steps.expected_outcome: All existing tests pass, no regressions

verification_steps.name: Integration Test - Database Migration
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Migration applies successfully, columns created with constraints

verification_steps.name: E2E Test - Full Flow
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Complete data flow works: admin input -> database -> display

verification_strategy.reasoning: High risk due to database schema changes affecting existing products table. Requires comprehensive testing including unit tests (type checking), integration tests (migration), and E2E tests (full data flow). Staging deployment essential to verify migration on production-like data.

checks: ProductCard shows nutritional info when data exists
No errors for products without nutritional data
Products table has protein, carbohydrates, fat columns
Existing product data intact after migration
